headline: Independent MP Helen Haines injured in incident outside Wangaratta office in regional Victoria

members.title: Independent MP Helen Haines injured in incident outside Wangaratta office in regional Victoria
members.lead: Anthony Albanese says his thoughts remain with Indi MP after arrest of driver in Wangaratta on Monday afternoon ‘Everything you would want from a politician’: who is Helen Haines, the MP allegedly attacked in Victoria? Helen Haines updates: PM says person in custody after alleged attack on Helen Haines – follow live The independent MP Helen Haines has been critically injured in an alleged attack involving a vehicle outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, in regional Victoria. The prime minister, Anthony Albanese, confirmed on Monday night that a man is in custody after an alleged attack on Haines that was now being investigated by the Australian federal police (AFP), Asio and the joint counter-terror taskforce. members.title: Who is Helen Haines, the MP allegedly attacked in Victoria?
members.lead: Condemnation across political spectrum after incident in Wangaratta, as Nationals MP from nearby electorate says Haines ‘not a divisive figure’ Dr Helen Haines, the popular independent MP for Indi, was hit by a car on Monday in what prime minister Anthony Albanese described as an “attack” and a “deliberate act”. The incident has sent shockwaves through federal politics, with the bombshell of the apparent attack – of a type not seen in Australian public life – amplified by the fact it targeted Haines, a principled politician who is well-respected by virtually all across the parliament.
